name: io.github.anand-kamble/mcp-instagram
title: Instagram
description: Read Instagram profiles, posts, stories and comments, and like, comment and follow.

environmentVariables.name: IG_USERNAME
environmentVariables.description: Instagram username. Needed to log in; every tool except login and logout needs a session.

environmentVariables.name: IG_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Instagram password. Sent only in the login request and never written to disk.

environmentVariables.name: IG_SESSION_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Private directory for the saved session (default: ~/.config/mcp-instagram, or %APPDATA%\mcp-instagram on Windows).

environmentVariables.name: IG_RATE_LIMITS
environmentVariables.description: JSON overrides for like/comment/follow/login limits, e.g. {"like":{"perHour":100}}.
